dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. I had a terrible day yesterday.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈtɛrəbəl ˈdeɪ ˈjɛstərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! What was the problem?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈprɑːbləm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: First, I missed the bus, so I didn't get to class on time.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, aɪ ˈmɪst ðə ˈbʌs, soʊ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈɡɛt tə ˈklæs ɑːn ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then I lost my wallet and my keys! I didn't have money for lunch.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪ ˈlɔːst maɪ ˈwɑːlɪt ənd maɪ ˈkiːz! aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhæv ˈmʌni fər ˈlʌntʃ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Where are they now?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwɛr ər ðeɪ ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In my bag! I didn't look in it.
dialogue.reading: ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ! aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈlʊk ɪn ɪt.
